{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df_clean = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
df_clean = df_clean.sort_values(by=["patient_id", "sample_seq"], ascending=[True, False])
df_clean = df_clean.drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Step 3: Check if assay_batch affects biomarker_baseline
# Group by assay_batch and compute mean baseline biomarker
batch_means = df_clean.groupby("assay_batch")["biomarker_baseline"].agg(["mean", "count"])
print("Mean baseline biomarker by assay_batch:")
print(batch_means)

# Check if batch B values are systematically higher, which would suggest µg/L vs ng/mL
# If batch B mean is ~10× batch A mean, then batch B is in µg/L and must be divided by 10
batch_a_mean = batch_means.loc["A", "mean"]
batch_b_mean = batch_means.loc["B", "mean"]

print(f"\nBatch A mean: {batch_a_mean:.2f} ng/mL")
print(f"Batch B mean: {batch_b_mean:.2f} ng/mL")
print(f"Ratio (B/A): {batch_b_mean / batch_a_mean:.2f}")

# If ratio is ~10, then batch B is in µg/L and must be divided by 10
if abs(batch_b_mean / batch_a_mean - 10) < 0.1:
    print("\nConclusion: Batch B baseline values are likely in µg/L (10× too large). Correcting by dividing by 10.")
    df_clean.loc[df_clean["assay_batch"] == "B", "biomarker_baseline"] /= 10
else:
    print("\nConclusion: Batch B values are not ~10× higher than Batch A. No correction needed.")"}
